description: One of the 150 psalms of the Asteria app, in full, verse by verse, by number (Hebrew numbering; its Latin number is noted when it differs), with what it is used for: the guardian angel who says one of its verses, what it is said against, the rituals that have it said. Or, with "against", which psalms to say against something, as the app lists them ("Which psalm to say against…"): crowd, lies, talk, envy, hatred, enemies, wickedWoman, wickedMen, powerful, diabolical, blackMagic, evilForces, evilEye.

against.description: What to say a psalm against.

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

number.description: Psalm number, 1–150 (Hebrew numbering, e.g. 91 for the Latin 90).

name: psalm
title: Psalm (full text and use)
